title: Seagrove Beach "30a Poolside Paradise " 71 Santa Clara Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "30a Poolside Paradise " 71 Santa Clara Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $70 per day.- Garage- Pool level bar with ice maker- 4 adult bikes- Wet bar- Grill- Outdoor living area- Spacious wrap-around balconies- Fenced-in back yard- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape for days of balmy breezes and blissful relaxation at 71 Santa Clara Street in Seagrove Beach. This 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home sleeps 12 guests and is a quick 3-minute stroll from beach access. Guests will love swimming in the pool and enjoying the multiple outdoor spaces.The sun-fueled fun starts in the enclosed backyard on the ground level of this 3-story home. Leafy palm trees and chaise lounge chairs flank the glistening private pool and sitting spa—complete with a sun shelf. A grill and a 6-person table on the patio makes it easy to whip up delicious burgers for lunch, while a shaded sitting space features a Smart TV for entertainment. An outdoor shower offers convenience after trips to the beach. Inside is a dry bar—no need to head upstairs for refreshments!Shiplap-clad walls, hardwood floors, and soothing shades of blue and white lend coastal elegance to the main-level great room. A spacious sectional, soft armchair, and Smart TV invite guests to unwind with friends and family after the day’s adventures. By the windows is a charming mid-century dining table with 4 wooden chairs and built-in bench seating. The kitchen boasts an open layout, high-end appliances, and a breakfast bar with 3 stools—perfect for hosting friends and mini taste-testers. Step onto the covered porch to enjoy an alfresco dinner at the picnic table or sip cocktails in the Adirondack chairs. Guests can retire for the night in either the guest bedroom with a king bed or the bunk room with a queen-over-queen bed on this level—all the bedrooms are equipped with a Roku TV.On the top level, guests will find a peaceful primary bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom, alongside a guest bedroom with 2 full beds and a private balcony furnished with 4 chairs.Beach adventures and family fun await at 71 Santa Clara Street. Effortlessly explore with on-site parking and 4 complimentary adult bikes—plus proximity to the Timpoochee Trail. Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is at the end of the street past East County Highway 30A. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
